metadata.title: Fetch PR and Comments
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Fetch PR details and all active comment threads with full conversation context from Azure DevOps. This is the loop entry point — runs at the start of each iteration cycle. If no active comments are found, downstream steps can exit early.

output.description: PR details and active comment threads with full conversation stored in memory

prerequisites: repository.id and pullRequestId available in memory from detect-repository step
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: read context from memory → fetch PR details → list active threads → fetch full comments per thread → store in memory
Use MCP tools exclusively for ADO data — do not use REST API directly
If pullRequestId is null in memory, report error and STOP — PR must exist before comments can be fetched
When fetching threads, filter by status='Active' to only get unresolved comments
For each thread, fetch the full comment conversation — not just the first comment
bestPractices: Always fetch fresh thread data on each iteration — do not rely on cached data from previous cycles
Record activeThreadCount explicitly so downstream steps can check for early exit
Preserve the full thread context including file paths and line ranges for the analysis step
Log the count of active threads immediately for traceability
If this is a subsequent iteration (not the first), log which threads are new vs previously seen

substeps.name: Read Context from Memory
substeps.description: Load repository and PR identifiers from previous step
actions: Read repository.id and pullRequestId from memory
If pullRequestId is null: report error 'No PR linked to work item — cannot fetch comments' and STOP
Log: 'Fetching comments for PR #{pullRequestId} in repository {repository.id}'

substeps.name: Fetch PR Details
substeps.description: Get PR metadata from Azure DevOps
actions: Call mcp__azuredevops__repo_pull_request with repositoryId and pullRequestId
Extract: title, status, source branch, target branch, created by
If the call fails: report error and STOP
Log: 'PR #{pullRequestId}: {title} ({status})'

substeps.name: List Active Comment Threads
substeps.description: Fetch all unresolved comment threads on the PR
actions: Call mcp__azuredevops__repo_pull_request_thread with repositoryId, pullRequestId, and status filter for active threads
Count the active threads
If no active threads found: record activeThreadCount=0 in memory and log 'No active comments on PR' — downstream steps handle early exit
Log: 'Found {count} active comment threads'

substeps.name: Extract Thread Details
substeps.description: Parse each active thread for downstream analysis
actions: For each active thread, extract:
- threadId: thread identifier
- filePath: threadContext.filePath (the file being commented on)
- lineRange: rightFileStart.line to rightFileEnd.line
- comments: all comments in the thread with author and content
- author: first comment's author.displayName
- status: thread status
Build activeThreads array with all extracted data

substeps.name: Store Results in Memory
substeps.description: Write PR and thread data to memory
actions: Write to memory: pr.title, pr.status, pr.sourceBranch, activeThreadCount, activeThreads array
If this is a subsequent iteration, note which threads are new

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: activeThreadCount is recorded (even if 0)
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Linear flow: Read context → Fetch PR details → List active threads → Extract thread details → Store in memory → Compliance check. If no active threads found at substep 2, store activeThreadCount=0 and continue (early exit handled by template).

fields: Information Produced: pr.title, pr.status, pr.sourceBranch, activeThreadCount, activeThreads (array of thread objects with threadId, filePath, lineRange, comments, author, status)
Notes: Count of active threads, any threads that failed to fetch
